passage.quote: Descriptions and links organize that account around responsibilities. A description should explain its subject without requiring the reader to follow its links. Children elaborate particular passages at whatever depth is useful; implementation links identify the source that realizes a claim. Descriptions can also state behavior that is only partly implemented, with the remaining work made explicit.

summary: Each description explains one responsibility on its own; children elaborate meaningful passages at variable depths.
Stable identities connect Markdown descriptions and JSON metadata; exact quotes locate implementation and other linked passages.
Agents create and maintain summary bullets with each description. Older content without summaries and broken metadata remain readable.
